name: Inkanyamba — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Inkanyamba from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Inkanyamba" but are not part of the Inkanyamba entry, which is unchanged.

DEFENSE

AC 29, touch 6, flat-footed 25 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +23 natural, -8 size)
hp 212 (17d10+119)
Fort +17, Ref +15, Will +10
DR 10/magic; Immune electricity, poison

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., swim 60 ft.
Melee bite +25 (8d6+16 plus grab and poison), tail slap +20 (6d6+8)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 20 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon, constrict (8d6+16), hypnotic sway, protean venom
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 17th, concentration +22)
